payload.query: Can I wear black and brown together?

args.text: Yes, black and brown can be worn together when they are clearly different shades, such as wearing dark jeans with brown boots [color-matching#3]. However, for more formal outfits, it is recommended to keep your shoes and belt in the same colour family (e.g., brown shoes with a brown belt or black shoes with a black belt) [color-matching#3].
